keyEvents.text: Goal! Deportivo de A Coruña 0, Osasuna 1. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Moi Gómez.
Moi Gómez (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Deportivo de A Coruña 0, Osasuna 1.
Second Half begins Deportivo de A Coruña 0, Osasuna 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Adama Traoré replaces Giacomo Quagliata.
Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Deportivo de A Coruña 1, Osasuna 1. Mario Soriano (Deportivo de A Coruña) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang replaces Luismi Cruz.
Substitution, Osasuna. Rubén García replaces Jonathan Dubasin.
Substitution, Osasuna. Asier Osambela replaces Raúl Moro.
Substitution, Osasuna. Iñigo Arguibide replaces Jon Moncayola.
Substitution, Osasuna. Raúl García replaces Ante Budimir.
Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Kike Barja (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Deportivo de A Coruña 2, Osasuna 1. Bil Nsongo (Deportivo de A Coruña) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Osasuna. Kike Barja replaces Valentin Rosier.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Ximo Navarro replaces David Mella.
Substitution, Deportivo de A Coruña. Riki Rodríguez replaces Mario Soriano.
